note.explanation: A computer works as a system: its components work together to process data and perform tasks. Input devices let users give commands, processing components handle data, storage keeps data, and output devices present results. The motherboard and system bus help components communicate.
examples: Clicking a document with a mouse gives the computer input; the operating system determines what action to take, and the computer displays the file.
A printer is a peripheral that can produce output from a computer.
note.checkAnswer: The system bus carries data between the CPU and other connected components.
note.simple: A computer system is a team of parts. Each part has a job, and the parts communicate to get work done.

written.text: Q1.3. Describe the main components of a computer system.
written.finalAnswer: A computer system has interface, processing, and communication components. Interface components include input devices such as a keyboard and mouse, and output devices such as a monitor and printer. Processing components include the CPU, RAM, storage, operating system, and application software. Communication components include the motherboard and system bus, which connect components and transmit data and signals.

written.text: Q1.5. Describe the main characteristics of a computer as a system, including its objectives, components, and interactions among these components.
written.finalAnswer: A computer is a complex system designed to process data and perform tasks according to a set of instructions. Its objective is to perform computations, process data, and execute tasks efficiently. It has interface components, processing components, and communication components. These components interact: for example, a mouse or keyboard sends input, the operating system determines the appropriate action, the CPU processes commands, storage supplies or keeps data, and an output device presents results.

written.text: Q1.7. Provide a detailed explanation of how a computer interacts with its environment. Include examples of user input, network communication, and power supply.
written.finalAnswer: A computer system environment includes external devices that interact with the computer. A power supply provides electrical power so the computer can work. A network connects it to other systems and the Internet, allowing it to send and receive data to browse websites or download files. Peripherals such as printers, scanners, and external discs expand its capabilities. For example, a user types on a keyboard and the computer processes the input to display text on the screen.

written.text: Q1.8. Describe the process of retrieving and displaying a file using a computer, based on the interactions among different components. Provide a step-by-step explanation of how input is processed, data is transferred, and results are displayed on the screen.
written.finalAnswer: The user double-clicks a file icon with a mouse or presses a key combination. The mouse or keyboard sends a signal to the computer through its connection. The operating system receives the information from the interface component and determines the appropriate action. The file is retrieved from storage, and the CPU processes the required instructions and data, using RAM as transient storage. Data is transferred between components through the system bus. The monitor displays the file's contents.

explain.title: A computer has an objective
explain.body: A computer is a complex system designed to process data and perform tasks according to a set of instructions. Its objective is to perform computations, process data, and execute tasks efficiently.

explain.title: The components have different jobs
explain.body: Interface components let users interact with the computer and receive results. Processing components include the CPU, RAM, storage, operating system, and application software. Communication components connect computer parts and help information move between them.

explain.title: Components communicate and work together
explain.body: The motherboard is the primary circuit board that interconnects components. The system bus transmits data between the CPU and other components. For example, opening a file starts with mouse or keyboard input; the operating system determines the action and the file is shown on the screen.

explain.title: A computer also interacts with its environment
explain.body: The environment includes external devices and connections such as a power supply, network, and peripherals. A computer needs electrical power, can send and receive data over a network, and can use peripherals such as printers and scanners.

mistakes: Do not confuse RAM, which is transient storage, with a hard drive or SSD, which provides permanent storage.
Do not describe the CPU as the component that receives all user input and decides what action to take; the operating system determines the appropriate action.
Do not mix up input devices, such as a keyboard and mouse, with output devices, such as a monitor and printer.
Do not say that the motherboard itself performs all computations; it interconnects the components.
When explaining a process, do not skip the order from user input to processing and then output.
